description: SlideSpeak turns your prompt into a polished presentation without leaving ChatGPT. Describe the topic and audience, watch the deck generate right in the chat with live slide previews, then open the finished presentation in the SlideSpeak editor to customize, share, or export it. Generation uses the credits included with your SlideSpeak account.

defaultPrompt: Create a presentation about the impact of remote work on team productivity
Make a pitch deck for a sustainable coffee subscription startup
Create a training presentation on giving effective feedback, for new managers
